timeZone.description: For kickoffs written without a UTC offset, when the row has no Time zone column; the web app sends the browser's. UTC when not given.

dateOrder.description: How to read dates written with slashes or dots (7/11/2026); ISO dates (2026-11-07) need none. mdy when not given.

dryRun.description: Check every row and say what would happen, without saving anything (IMP-5).

description: Matches to add or update, from a spreadsheet, CSV or JSON file (IMP-1 to IMP-8).
